Hi Sam — thanks for sending the ACH form. Quick checklist to move this through finance:

1) W-9 (PDF) or equivalent tax form — we need this for vendor records.
2) Bank proof: voided check OR bank letter on letterhead confirming account ownership (your bank prefers issuing letters).
3) Confirmation that the account accepts ACH credits (sometimes banks flag corporate accounts).
4) Vendor contact for remittance emails and invoice routing.

Process notes: our procurement requires a PO before we pay the first invoice — finance will generate PO-2027-7891 once bank proof & W-9 are received and micro-deposits verify. Micro-deposits usually post within 48–72 hours; we'll ask accounting to trigger them as soon as we have the bank details.

If you can upload the items to our vendor portal (link below) that's fastest: https://console.redwood.com/vendor-portal/kiteworks (or reply with attachments).

I'll loop in Jonas from finance to watch for the micro-deposit confirmation.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
